definitions.short: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus
definitions.full: H2983. Yebusi יְבֻסִי יְבוּסִי, 1. adjective, of a people Jebusite, Jebusites , singular הַיְבֻסִי אורנה 2Sam 24:16 , 18 compare 1Chr 21:15 , 18 , 28 ; 2Chr 3:1 ; as substantive a Jebusite Zech 9:7 ; usually with article ׳הַי collective the Jebusites , in historical statement Gen 10:16 (J) = 1Chr 1:14 ; Num 13:29 (E) Josh 9:1 ; 11:3 ; 12:8 ; 24:11 (all D) Judg 3:5 ; Neh 9:8 , all in list of Canaanitish peoples; so also 1Kin 9:20 2Chr 8:7 , where remnant of these peoples referred to; also Ezra 9:1 , which seems to shew that this list had become a standing expression for early inhabitants; compare further in promises (J E D) Gen 15:21 ; Exod 3:8 , 17 ; 13:5 ; 23:23 ; 33:2 ; 34:11 ; Deut 7:1 ; 20:17 ; Josh 3:10 ; specifically defined as inhabitants of Jebus-Jerusalem 15:63 (twice in verse) (J) Judg 1:21 (twice in verse); 2Sam 5:6 , 8 (on which compare Dr) 1Chr 11:4 (called also הָאָרֶץ יוֺשֵׁב 2Sam 5:6 & הָאָרֶץ ישְׁבֵי 1Chr 11:4 ); see also הַזּאֹת הַיְבוּסִי עִיר Judg 19:11 ; whence 2 Jerusalem , Hexateuch only P, Josh 15:8 יְרוּשָׁלָ֑םִ הִיא מִנֶּגֶב היבוסי אֶלכֶּֿתֶף בֶןהִֿנֹּם גֵּי , compare 18:16 , 28 יְרוּשָׁלַםִ הִיא וְהַיְבוּסִי . — compare כנען .
